evidence.quote: aplicação de componentes semicondutores, displays e painéis solares no País

summary.short: Law 14.968/2024 creates the Brasil Semicon program and amends tax, R&D credit and Padis rules for semiconductor, display, solar-panel and ICT manufacturers in Brazil. It takes effect 1 January 2025, and its incentives run until 31 December 2029.
summary.long: Law 14.968/2024 creates the Programa Brasil Semicondutores (Brasil Semicon) to support research, design, production and application of semiconductor components, displays and solar panels in Brazil (Art. 3). It authorizes a management council (Art. 4) and BNDES and Finep to structure financing and minority equity support for firms enrolled in Padis (Art. 5). It amends Decree-Law 288/1967 (10-percentage-point increase for nationally developed ICT products, Art. 6), Law 8.248/1991 (R&D financial credit and reporting duties, Art. 7), Law 13.969/2019 (credit multipliers and caps, Art. 8) and Law 11.484/2007 (Art. 9). Under Law 11.484, Padis enrolment requires a specific act conditioned on tax compliance; enrolled firms get reduced rates on PIS/Cofins, IPI and import duty, a 100% income-tax reduction on device sales, and must invest at least 5% of incentivised gross revenue in R&D yearly. Non-compliance causes loss of the reduction and payment of the tax with interest and late-payment fine. The Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation defines rules on nationally developed technology (Art. 10). Incentives run until 31 December 2029 (Art. 11); the law takes effect 1 January 2025 (Art. 13).

enforcement.max_penalty_text: perda do direito à redução de alíquotas e obrigação de recolher, com relação à importância distribuída, o imposto que a pessoa jurídica tiver deixado de pagar, acrescido de juros e multa de mora, na forma da lei
enforcement.penalty_formula: Loss of the tax-rate reduction, plus repayment of the tax not paid on the distributed amount, with interest and late-payment fine; no rate for the interest or fine is stated in this text
enforcement.penalty_reference: na forma da lei (the rate and procedure are left to the law; not specified in this text)

evidence.quote: A inobservância do disposto nos §§ 3º a 5º deste artigo importa perda do direito à redução de alíquotas [The non-observance of the provisions of §§ 3 to 5 of this article results in loss of the right to the tax-rate reduction]
